reason: A is the better proposal because it specifies a composition, controlled substitution, electronic mediator, baseline measurements, and a direct DOS–Tc test, whereas B simultaneously changes electron count and strain without separating their effects or predicting a directional trend. A nevertheless requires revision because the assumed ~7.5 K baseline and 1–2 K increase are unsupported extrapolations, and replacing V with Ti is not established to increase the Fermi-level DOS.
